name: 原子：链路列表行操作按钮验证
description: 验证每行数据的编辑、复制按钮可见可点击

steps.expression: return (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('table tbody tr'); const dataRows = [...rows].filter(r => r.querySelectorAll('td').length > 0); const results = []; for (const row of dataRows.slice(0, 3)) { const ops = row.querySelector('td:last-child'); const btns = ops ? [...ops.querySelectorAll('button')].map(b => ({ text: b.textContent.trim(), visible: b.offsetHeight > 0, disabled: b.disabled })) : []; const name = row.querySelector('td')?.textContent.trim(); results.push({ name: name?.substring(0, 30), buttons: btns }); } return results; })()
